description: Paste any YouTube link or video ID to preview every available thumbnail size and download the one you need in a single click.

faqs.a: Standard watch URLs, youtu.be short links, /shorts/, /embed/ and /live/ links all work, and so does pasting the raw 11-character video ID.
YouTube only generates the extra-large 1280x720 thumbnail for videos uploaded in HD. If it does not exist, this tool hides it instead of showing a broken image.
faqs.q: Why is the HD (maxresdefault) thumbnail missing for some videos?

faqs.a: No. Only thumbnails of public videos (and unlisted ones, if you know the link) can be fetched. Private or deleted videos return nothing.
faqs.q: Can I download thumbnails from private videos?

howto: Paste a YouTube video URL (watch, youtu.be, Shorts, embed or live link) or just the 11-character video ID.
Click "Get Thumbnails" to load every available thumbnail size for that video.
Preview each size — sizes that do not exist are hidden automatically.
Click Download on any size to save it to your device.
title: YouTube Thumbnail Downloader
